description: This file declares the PartialData class which provides support for handling HTTP range requests and partial content responses, including cache validation and range management, within the Chromium project.

classes.name: PartialData
classes.description: A class managing HTTP range requests, cache validation, and partial content responses, tightly integrated with Chromium's HTTP cache system.

methods.name: PartialData
methods.description: Constructor for PartialData.

methods.name: Init
methods.description: Initializes the object by examining request headers to verify if the range can be processed.

methods.name: SetHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers for making byte range requests, removing range-related headers.

methods.name: RestoreHeaders
methods.description: Restores byte-range headers by appending the range to the provided headers.

methods.name: ShouldValidateCache
methods.description: Checks if cache validation is needed for the current range.

methods.name: PrepareCacheValidation
methods.description: Builds headers for cache validation of the next range.

methods.name: IsCurrentRangeCached
methods.description: Checks if the current range is stored in cache.

methods.name: IsLastRange
methods.description: Checks if the current range is the last needed to fulfill the request.

methods.name: UpdateFromStoredHeaders
methods.description: Updates internal state from stored cache headers.

methods.name: SetRangeToStartDownload
methods.description: Resets the current range to start from zero.

methods.name: IsRequestedRangeOK
methods.description: Validates if the requested range is acceptable.

methods.name: ResponseHeadersOK
methods.description: Checks if response headers match expectations.

methods.name: FixResponseHeaders
methods.description: Adjusts response headers to include correct content length and range.

methods.name: FixContentLength
methods.description: Adjusts the content length in headers for cache storage.

methods.name: CacheRead
methods.description: Reads data from cache for the current range.

methods.name: CacheWrite
methods.description: Writes data to cache for the current range.

methods.name: OnCacheReadCompleted
methods.description: Updates internal state after cache read completes.

methods.name: OnNetworkReadCompleted
methods.description: Updates internal state after network read completes.

methods.name: GetNextRangeLen
methods.description: Determines the length of the next cache scan range.

methods.name: GetAvailableRangeCompleted
methods.description: Callback for when available range info is retrieved.
